lines.en: : Come to think of it, why is everyone always taking me on trips to bond with me? Can I not be bonded with from the comfort of my own home?
lines.zh: : 话说回来,为什么大家总是要用旅行来和我培养感情?就不能在自家舒服地完成吗?

lines.en: : No. Because that is where your father lives. And so long as he is present, you are unbondable.
lines.zh: : 不行。因为你父亲住在你家。只要他在场,你就不可联结。

lines.en: : Unless it’s bond-age. I’ve found that that’s best done from the comfort of one’s own home as it’s an inherently safer environment that’s easier to establish boundaries in.
lines.zh: : 除非说的是 bond-age(捆绑之缘)。我发现那种事在自己家里做最舒服——本来就是更安全、更容易划定界限的环境。

lines.en: : See, Aunt Niki? If you want to tie me up and do things to me, at least let me stay in bed for it. How do you expect me to accept you as a mother if you can’t even do that much?
lines.zh: : 是吧,Niki 姨?你要是想绑住我、对我做点什么,至少让我躺在床上做吧。你要是连这个都做不到,怎么指望我接受你当妈妈?

lines.en: : Thank you, Noriko. Now Ami completely understands what this trip is all about. And here I was worried all the ropes and shackles would intimidate her.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Noriko。现在 Ami 彻底明白这趟旅行的意义了。我还一直担心那些绳索和镣铐会吓到她呢。

lines.en: : They might at first, but only because all of my experience with stuff like that is on the opposite end.
lines.zh: : 一开始也许会,但只是因为我所有相关的经验,都站在绳子的另一头。

lines.en: : Who was the person you tied up, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你绑过的那个人是谁,Ami?

lines.en: : Maya.
lines.zh: : Maya。

lines.en: : Lucky! I want to do that! Then she’d be forced to like me or she’d have to stay my prisoner forever.
lines.zh: : 好羡慕!我也想那样!那样她就只能被迫喜欢我,不然就得永远当我的囚犯。

lines.en: : Maya’s that girl who has a crush on Akira, right?
lines.zh: : Maya 就是暗恋 Akira 的那个女孩,对吧?

lines.en: : You could say that about literally everyone I know and you’d still be correct.
lines.zh: : 这话拿来形容我认识的任何一个人都成立,你还是不会错。

lines.en: : No, I mean the one who threw a temper tantrum and stormed out of the house on Halloween. She was dressed up as Haruhi Suzumiya, wasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 不,我是说万圣节那天发脾气摔门跑出家的那个。她 cos 的是凉宫春日,对吧?

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. That’s Maya alright. Leave it to her to pick someone as dated as Haruhi Suzumiya. She’s like one Halloween off from going as Kagome or something.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。那就是 Maya 没错。挑一个过气成凉宫春日的,也就她干得出来。她再过一个万圣节,就该 cos 戈薇了吧。

lines.en: : Are you trying to start a fight with me, child?
lines.zh: : 你是想跟我吵架吗,小孩?

lines.en: : Don’t feel bad, Nee-chan! I personally love how you’re stuck in the era you grew up in.
lines.zh: : 别难过嘛,姐!我个人非常喜欢你还卡在你长大的那个年代。

lines.en: : It makes me feel less weird about the dramatic gap in time between the unprotected sex our parents had when they were creating us.
lines.zh: : 这样一来,想到爸妈生我们俩时隔了好多年,我就不觉得那么怪了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Noriko. I’m very glad you reminded me of our parents having unprotected sex. Make that two times today I have had to think of our father in that context now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Noriko。我真高兴你提醒了我爸妈的无套性爱。这已经是今天第二次,我不得不在这种语境下想起我们爸了。

lines.en: : Well jeez, Nee-chan. I know you love our dad, I just didn’t realize you loved him that much.
lines.zh: : 哎呀姐,我知道你爱我们爸,只是没想到你爱到这个地步。

lines.en: : THAT’S NOT WHAT I MEANT!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思!

lines.en: : Sex with dads and how okay it is aside, I’m excited for this trip! I had a ton of fun with Sara when I went camping last time, so maybe this’ll be just as good?
lines.zh: : 先不论和爸爸做爱与它的可接受程度——我好期待这趟旅行!上次露营我和 Sara 玩得超开心,这次说不定也一样?

lines.en: : Sara? Who is Sara? What is Sara? Why is Sara? Why did you go camping with her?
lines.zh: : Sara?谁是 Sara?Sara 是什么?为什么是 Sara?你为什么跟她去露营?

lines.en: : A friend’s mom. She’s the one who cut my hair. Super nice lady. Loves my dad maybe just as much as you do, Aunt Niki.
lines.zh: : 一个朋友的妈妈。剪我头发的就是她。人超好。也许跟你一样爱我们爸呢,Niki 姨。

lines.en: : Well I’m sure she’s a very nice lady.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我确信她是位非常好的女士。

lines.en: : Ooooh, Nee-chan’s jealous now.
lines.zh: : 哦——姐吃醋了。

lines.en: : Really? But why would Niki be jealous of a super nice and motherly woman who has already spent time bonding with me and reminding me of how a mother’s touch feels?
lines.zh: : 才没有!话说 Niki 为什么要吃一位超好、又充满母性、已经跟我培养过感情、还提醒了我母亲的抚摸是什么滋味的女人的醋?

lines.en: : I’m not jealous at all! I mean...I’m a famous idol. And she’s your friend’s mother, so of course she’s already spoken for. There’s nothing for me to be jealous of.
lines.zh: : 我根本没有吃醋!我是说……我是著名偶像。而她是你朋友的妈妈,所以她当然已经名花有主。我没什么可吃醋的。

lines.en: : Actually, Sara’s husband walked out on her a long time ago. She’s single now. And desperately looking for a new man to take care of her daughter.
lines.zh: : 其实,Sara 的丈夫很多年前就跑了。她现在单身。而且正拼命寻找一个新男人,来照顾她的女儿。

lines.en: : Is she fat?
lines.zh: : 她胖吗?

lines.en: : Nee-chan! That’s mean!
lines.zh: : 姐!这样太坏了!

lines.en: : What?! I’m allowed to ask!
lines.zh: : 什么?!我有权问!

lines.en: : She’s not! She’s actually really small and super pretty! She could probably pass as a teenager if she really wanted to.
lines.zh: : 她不胖!她又娇小又超级漂亮!她要真想,都能冒充未成年少女!

lines.en: : FUCK!
: Patrice! Pull over!
lines.zh: : Patrice!靠边停车!

lines.en: : I can’t. There’s no shoulder. And I’m not going to just let you go out of the car to throw a tantrum. We’re on a highway. That’s a PR disaster waiting to happen.
lines.zh: : 做不到。这里没有路肩。而且我也不能放你下车发脾气。我们在高速公路上。等着发生的公共关系灾难。

lines.en: : You’re only saying that because you’ve never been in love, you fucking whore! Drive us off a cliff then! That’ll teach that bastard to bring other moms into the picture!
lines.zh: : 你这么说只是因为你从没恋爱过,你这个死贱人!那你就把车开下悬崖吧!这样那个混蛋就记住了,不许把别的妈妈扯进来!

lines.en: : Uhh...Nee-chan? When you say “other moms,” could it be that you’re forgetting you’re not one of those? Unless- ah! You’re pregante!
lines.zh: : 呃……姐?你说「别的妈妈」的时候,是不是忘了你自己也算一个?除非——啊!你 pregante 了!

lines.en: : Aunt Niki’s prangent?! Since when?!
lines.zh: : Niki 姨 prangent 了?!从什么时候开始的?!

lines.en: : I am not pergenat! I’m just leaving open the possibility that one day, I might be?
lines.zh: : 我没有 pergenat!我只是保留着「也许有一天会」的可能性!

lines.en: : Why can’t any of you pronounce the word “pregnant?”
lines.zh: : 你们为什么没一个能把「怀孕」这个词念对?

lines.en: : Have you never been on the fucking Internet before, Patrice?! Pull over!
lines.zh: : 你他妈从来没上过网吗,Patrice?!靠边停车!

lines.en: : To use the Internet?
lines.zh: : 上网?

lines.en: : No! To throw yourself into the ocean, you slimy cunt!
lines.zh: : 不!把你扔进海里,你这黏糊糊的贱货!

lines.en: And so the car was ultimately brought to a stop just five minutes from the girls’ final destination.
lines.zh: 于是,车最终在距离女孩们终点五分钟的地方停了下来。

lines.en: With her manager hovering over her and shielding her from the passing cars, dashcams, and prying eyes, Niki then proceeded to curse her childhood friend to a lifetime worth of erectile dysfunction whenever she wasn’t around.
lines.zh: 经纪人俯身替她挡住来往的车辆、行车记录仪和窥探的目光,Niki 则开始诅咒她的青梅竹马:只要她不在场,就终身勃起功能障碍。

lines.en: Of course, this would very much not be the case. And he would proceed to have erections around basically everyone because that’s just the kind of guy he was.
lines.zh: : 当然,事情根本不会如此。他会照旧在几乎所有人面前勃起,因为他就是那种人。

lines.en: On the inside of the limo, though, an awkward silence took the place of the girl who occupied the middle seat just seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 而在豪华轿车内部,一个尴尬的沉默,取代了几秒钟前还坐在中间座位上的那个女孩。

lines.en: Because, while Noriko was brought along to cultivate a more bond-friendly environment, the truth was she still didn’t know how to feel about Ami.
lines.zh: : 因为,虽然把 Noriko 带来是为了营造更适合培养感情的环境,但真相是,她对 Ami 依然不知道该作何感想。

lines.en: But Ami knew how to feel about her.
lines.zh: : 但 Ami 知道该对她作何感想。

lines.en: And what Noriko did not yet understand is that, for perhaps the first time ever, she’d be on the receiving end of what could only be called “faith.”
lines.zh: : 而 Noriko 还不明白的是:或许是生平第一次,她将站在一种只能称之为「信仰」的东西的接受端。

lines.en: Not faith in a god. Not faith in a friend. Not even faith in what was now essentially family.
lines.zh: : 不是对神的信仰。不是对朋友的信仰。甚至不是对如今实质上已成家人的信仰。

lines.en: Just faith that she’d fulfill the role she needed to fill to keep the wheels of time spinning while everything else has stopped.
lines.zh: : 只是相信:她会履行她必须履行的职责,让时间的车轮继续转动——尽管其余的一切都已停摆。

lines.en: A pencil in the hand of God is as good as a pen in the hand of the Pope.
lines.zh: : 神手中的铅笔,不亚于教皇手中的钢笔。

lines.en: But when both of those tools are taken away, only one can write in blood.
lines.zh: : 但当两件工具都被夺走时,只有一件还能用血书写。

lines.en: The other must simply watch.
lines.zh: : 另一件,只能旁观。

lines.en: : Having some trouble there, Patrice?
lines.zh: : 遇到麻烦了,Patrice?

lines.en: : I’m honestly just surprised you only brought one bag.
lines.zh: : 说实话,我只惊讶你居然只带了一个包。

lines.en: : There are ten more in the car.
lines.zh: : 车里还有十个。

lines.en: : Niki, we’re here for one weekend...
lines.zh: : Niki,我们只待一个周末……

lines.en: : I know. I just thought you could use the exercise. Aren’t I the nicest client you’ve ever had?
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是觉得你可以锻炼锻炼。我是不是你遇过的最贴心的客户?

lines.en: : Hah...I’ll be back with everything else in a minute. But remember, we have a meeting with the photographer in-
lines.zh: : 哈……我马上去把剩下的搬来。但记住,我们和摄影师的见面在——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Fuck off. Thanks!
lines.zh: : 行行行。滚吧。谢了!

lines.en: : Poor Patrice. What did she ever do to anybody?
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Patrice。她到底招谁惹谁了?

lines.en: : Didn’t you threaten to kill her the last time you guys met?
lines.zh: : 你们上次见面,你不是威胁要杀她吗?

lines.en: : Oh, yeah...I guess I did.
lines.zh: : 哦,对……好像是。

lines.en: : You have a meeting already, Nee-chan? You don’t even get to settle in first?
lines.zh: : 姐,你已经有见面了?你都不先安顿一下?

lines.en: : It shouldn’t take long. I just have to go sign off on a few swimsuits. Make sure nothing’s too revealing or we might sell too many calendars and I’ll suddenly be drowning in money.
lines.zh: : 不会太久。我只要去给几件泳衣签字。确保没有太暴露的,不然我们可能卖出太多日历,我会突然被钱淹死。

lines.en: : This might be a weird question, but have you ever imagined how much you’d make if you did porn?
lines.zh: : 可能是个怪问题,但你想过没有,要是你去拍片能赚多少?

lines.en: : Not really. I’m too successful to have ever considered pivoting to that. I’m sure the offers will start rolling in once I’m retired, though.
lines.zh: : 没想过。我太成功了,从没考虑过转型那个。不过我确信,等我退休之后,邀约就会滚滚而来。

lines.en: : I’m already getting them.
lines.zh: : 我已经收到邀约了。

lines.en: : What? From who?
lines.zh: : 什么?谁发的?

lines.en: : Probably a bunch of companies who want to hire you and don’t realize how old I am. Social media’s a cesspool nowadays, Onee-chan.
lines.zh: : 大概是一堆想签你的公司,没意识到我多大。社交媒体如今就是个粪坑,Onee-chan。

lines.en: : Give me your phone. I don’t want those weirdos contacting you anymore.
lines.zh: : 把手机给我。我不想让那些怪人再联系你。

lines.en: : I can’t. There are too many nudes of Kirin in there and I don’t want you seeing them despite how badly she probably wants you to.
lines.zh: : 不行。里面有太多 Kirin 的裸照,我不想让你看到——尽管她多半巴不得你看。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine. Whatever. Just don’t fucking respond to any of those people, okay? I’ll have failed as a sister if you start doing porn. Which isn’t even mentioning how it could impact my career.
lines.zh: : 唉……行吧。随便。但别他妈回复那些人里的任何一个,好吗?你要是开始拍片,我这个姐姐就当失败了。这还没算上它对我事业的影响。

lines.en: : That was such a good opportunity to remind me how much you love me and you squandered it. Who am I to you, Nee-chan? Patrice?
lines.zh: : 这本是向我表达你有多爱我的绝佳机会,而你把它浪费了。我对你来说算什么,姐?Patrice 吗?

lines.en: : No. But you are a babysitter until I get back. Now, watch Ami and make sure she doesn’t contact Akira.
lines.zh: : 不是。但在你回来之前,你是临时保姆。看着 Ami,确保她联系不上 Akira。

lines.en: : Okay!
lines.zh: : 好的!

lines.en: : Noriko’s not even that much older than me!
lines.zh: : Noriko 也没比我大多少!

lines.en: : True! But Noriko doesn’t want to fuck her dad, so she’s clearly the more mature out of you! Be back soon!
lines.zh: : 对!但 Noriko 不想和她爸做,所以她显然比你们俩成熟!马上回来!

lines.en: : It’s 2020. How are there still girls out there who don’t want to fuck their dad?
lines.zh: : 都 2020 年了,怎么还有不想和自己爸做的女孩?

lines.en: : I want to fuck your dad. Does that count?
lines.zh: : 我想和你爸做。这算吗?

lines.en: : Close enough, I guess. I’m sure you will sooner or later too. I’m done trying to stop people from doing it.
lines.zh: : 差不多算吧。我确信你迟早也会。我已经放弃阻止别人了。

lines.en: : Wait, you are? Since when? How did that happen? This wasn’t just some extremely long, extremely creepy phase, was it?
lines.zh: : 等等,是吗?从什么时候?怎么发生的?这不会只是一个超长、超渗人的「阶段」吧?

lines.en: : Of course not. There’s just no way for me to get what I want by interfering anymore.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。只是再干涉下去,我也没法得到我想要的了。

lines.en: : And...what is it you want, Ami?
lines.zh: : 那……你想要什么,Ami?

lines.en: : Well, for one, I’d like Niki to stop trying to be my new mother when I already have a perfectly good one.
lines.zh: : 嗯,首先,我希望 Niki 别再试图当我的新妈妈——因为我已经有一个完美无缺的了。

lines.en: : You mean...Sara? Is that why you brought her up earlier? Cause it...did seem like you were trying to make her jealous. But I just thought-
lines.zh: : 你是说……Sara?你之前提她是这个原因?因为……确实有点像你在故意让她吃醋。但我以为——

lines.en: : I’m not talking about Sara. I’m talking about my mom. The same one I’ve always had.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是 Sara。我说的是我妈。一直都是同一个。

lines.en: : Uhh...Ami? I don’t know how to break this to you, but-
lines.zh: : 呃……Ami?我不知道该怎么开口,但是——

lines.en: : I know she’s dead, okay? But that doesn’t mean I’m okay with just replacing her. There are things she can still teach me from wherever she is now.
lines.zh: : 我知道她死了,行吗?但这不代表我乐意随便找人取代她。她现在无论在哪里,都还有东西可以教我。

lines.en: : She left a lot behind. Myself included, obviously. Someone trying to fill her shoes will only distract me from that.
lines.zh: : 她留下了很多。包括我自己,显然。任何试图填补她位置的人,都只会让我分心。

lines.en: : Nee-chan would never try to replace her though, Ami. She-
lines.zh: : 但姐绝不会试图取代她的,Ami。她——

lines.en: : I know. She said that herself. But it still doesn’t change the fact that she’s poking her nose where she shouldn’t. And she keeps trying to change me when my mom never would.
lines.zh: : 我知道。她自己说过。但这改变不了一个事实:她在多管闲事。而且她一直试图改变我——我妈从来不会那样。

lines.en: : I mean...l was still super little when your mom was around, but I’m pretty sure she wouldn’t be okay with her daughter trying to fuck her brother-in-law.
lines.zh: : 呃……你妈妈还在的时候,我还特别小,但我相当确定,她不会乐意看到自己的女儿试图勾引自己的姐夫。

lines.en: : She was taken away too soon, so I guess we’ll never really know. But I do know that the thought alone wouldn’t disturb her the way it does Niki.
lines.zh: : 她走得太早了,所以我们永远无法验证。但我确实知道:光是那个念头,都不会像 Niki 那样让她反感。

lines.en: : My mom understood the strange, sometimes carnal bonds two people who don’t belong together can have. She wouldn’t think I’m broken. Niki does.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈理解两个人之间那种奇怪的、有时带着肉欲的羁绊——哪怕他们本不该属于彼此。她不会觉得我坏掉了。Niki 会。

lines.en: : But what Niki doesn’t understand is that being “broken” is just an Arakawa family trait. We’re all like that.
lines.zh: : 可 Niki 不明白的是,「坏掉」本来就是荒川家的遗传。我们全家都这样。

lines.en: : She does understand that, though. That’s why she tries so hard to make things better for you and Nii-chan.
lines.zh: : 她其实明白的。所以才那么努力想让你和 Nii-chan 的生活变好。

lines.en: : But that’s her idea of better. Not ours. And forcing that on us the way she does isn’t going to do anything but hurt her in the long run.
lines.zh: : 但那是她眼中的「更好」。不是我们的。像她那样强行塞给我们,长远来看只会伤到她自己。

lines.en: : Is it just me...or are you, like...way smarter all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 是我错觉吗……还是说你突然……变聪明了一大截?

lines.en: : It’s just you! The only thing inside my head is spending time with my dad. So of course I’ll sound smarter when the conversation is centered around that.
lines.zh: : 错觉!我脑子里唯一的念头就是和我爸相处。所以只要话题围绕它,我听起来当然聪明。

lines.en: : I still need Makoto’s help for math and stuff, though. So don’t worry, Noriko! You’re still smarter than me!
lines.zh: : 不过数学什么的,我还是需要 Makoto 帮忙。所以放心吧,Noriko!你还是比我聪明!

lines.en: : Are you...happy, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你……幸福吗,Ami?

lines.en: : Sometimes. Sometimes, not. How about you?
lines.zh: : 有时候。有时候,不。你呢?

lines.en: : Sometimes...
lines.zh: : 有时候……

lines.en: : I doubt you actually care though...and you’re only just asking me because I asked you.
lines.zh: : 不过我怀疑你根本不在乎……你问我只是因为我先问了你。

lines.en: : Well, on that note, do you actually care about me?
lines.zh: : 那么,顺着这个话题,你真的在乎我吗?

lines.en: : Or do you only have to care about me because your “Nii-chan” does?
lines.zh: : 还是你「必须」在乎我,只因为你的「Nii-chan」在乎?

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have asked you if you were happy if I didn’t care.
lines.zh: : 如果我不在乎,我就不会问你幸福不幸福。

lines.en: : I do.
lines.zh: : 我在乎。

lines.en: : I shouldn’t, but I do.
lines.zh: : 我不应该在乎,但我在乎。

lines.en: : And I want you as a sister just as badly as Nee-chan wants you as a daughter, but I feel like there’s nothing either one of us can do to ever have you let us into your life that way.
lines.zh: : 而且我想让你当我妹妹的愿望,和姐想让你当女儿一样强烈。可我感觉,无论是我还是她,都没有办法让你真正接纳我们走进你的生活。

lines.en: : Why...would you want me as a sister? What do I bring to the table besides my dad?
lines.zh: : 为什么……你想让我当你妹妹?除了我爸,我还能给你带来什么?

lines.en: : Well, for one, it would be nice not secretly thinking you want to disembowel me all the time. But more than that...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 嗯,首先,不用再偷偷担心你随时想掏了我的肠子,就挺好。但比这更重要的是……我不知道。

lines.en: : I just feel like we’re supposed to be closer than we are. Like it’s weird that we’re the same age and Akira is the one I’m attached to.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得,我们本该比现在更亲密。我们同龄,而我依附的却是 Akira,这很怪。

lines.en: : Like, maybe if we met each other more when we were little, things would be different now? And I wouldn’t be as afraid of you as...as I am.
lines.zh: : 就是说,也许我们小时候多见几面,现在就会不一样?我也不会像……像现在这样怕你。

lines.en: : See? That. That...blank stare. I never know what you’re thinking. I never know if things are going well when I talk to you anymore. You’re just...I can’t tell what’s real and what’s not.
lines.zh: : 看?就是那个。那个……空洞的眼神。我从来不知道你在想什么。我再也不知道和你说话算不算顺利。你只是……我分不清什么是真的,什么不是。

lines.en: : That’s not your fault, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 那不是你的错,Noriko。

lines.en: : I’ve just made too many mistakes to ever give away what I’m really feeling anymore.
lines.zh: : 我犯过的错太多了,再也没办法暴露真实的感受。

lines.en: : But I’m glad you- wait.
lines.zh: : 但我很高兴你——等等。

lines.en: : Dad?
: Hello.
lines.zh: : 你们好。

lines.en: : N-N-NII-CHAN?!?!?! WHAT ARE YOU DOING HERE?! I TOLD YOU THAT THIS NEEDED TO BE A STEALTH OPERATION AND YOU’RE JUST BARGING IN?!
lines.zh: : 爸——爸?!?!?!你在这里干什么?!我说了这必须是秘密行动,你居然就这么闯进来?!

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m not good at stealth.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我不擅长潜行。

lines.en: : SO YOU OPEN UP THE POSSIBILITY FOR ME TO BE SACRIFICED TO A DEMON?!
lines.zh: : 所以你开门让我有可能被献祭给恶魔?!

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot that was the penalty for this.
lines.zh: : 哦,对。我忘了这是违规的惩罚。

lines.en: : Wait, I’m confused. Noriko, did you invite him? Because I was going to invite him as soon as I had a chance. But-
lines.zh: : 等等,我糊涂了。Noriko,是你邀请他的?因为我本来打算一有机会就邀请他。但是——

lines.en: : I TOLD YOU, PATRICE! NO ICE! THERE’S LESS DRINK IF THERE’S ICE! SERIOUSLY, WHAT ARE YOU EVEN GOOD FOR?!
lines.zh: : 我说过,PATRICE!不许加冰!加了冰饮料就变少了!说真的,你到底有什么用?!

lines.en: : SAVE YOUR QUESTIONS! IT’S TIME TO HIDE!
lines.zh: : 把问题都省省!该藏起来了!

lines.en: : AND NOW IT’S TIME TO DESTROY!
lines.zh: : 然后该出来搞破坏了!

lines.en: : Yeah! How dare you accept Noriko’s invitation and not the one I wanted to make but haven't had the chance to yet!
lines.zh: : 对!你怎么敢接受 Noriko 的邀请,却不接受我还没来得及发出的那个!

lines.en: : Now it’s going to look like she’s the one who wanted you here more and that’s simply not true!
lines.zh: : 现在看起来倒像她更想要你来——而那根本不是真的!

lines.en: : Okay, sorry. But do you guys really need to pin me up against the wall to yell at me?
lines.zh: : 好吧,抱歉。但你们俩真有必要把我按在墙上吼吗?

lines.en: : Of course we do! There’s no room in here!
lines.zh: : 当然有!这屋里根本没空间!

lines.en: : There’s tons of room. Just look. You don’t need to-
lines.zh: : 空间大得很。你看。你们不需要——

lines.en: : It’s so cramped in here!
lines.zh: : 这里挤死了!

lines.en: : Yeah! I can barely move!
lines.zh: : 对!我几乎动不了!

lines.en: : Seriously?
lines.zh: : 认真的吗?

lines.en: : Wait — shh. I don’t know how familiar you are with Nakayama Sister Law. But 19A-B-42L states-
lines.zh: : 等等——嘘。我不知道你对中姐妹法则有多熟。但 19A-B-42L 条规定——

lines.en: : Demon sacrifice. I know.
lines.zh: : 献祭恶魔。我知道。

lines.en: : You’ve been studying. I like it.
lines.zh: : 你有在学习。我喜欢。

lines.en: : Yeah, no problem. Now, can somebody explain to me what’s going on? Because it’s starting to look like you invited my dad here so you wouldn’t have to be the third wheel while Aunt Niki tries to bond with me.
lines.zh: : 嗯,小事。那么,现在有人能给我解释一下这是什么情况吗?因为看起来,你们邀请我爸来,是为了在 Niki 姨试图和我培养感情时,自己不用当电灯泡。

lines.en: : No! I-
lines.zh: : 不是!我——

lines.en: : Oh. Actually, yeah. That’s exactly what happened.
lines.zh: : 哦。其实,对。事实正是如此。

lines.en: : What the heck, Noriko?! There’s no way I’m going to be able to escape from your sister once she gets back! How am I supposed to live knowing my dad is so close but I can’t reach him?!
lines.zh: : 搞什么,Noriko?!你姐一回来看见,我根本逃不掉!知道我爸近在咫尺却碰不到,我以后还怎么活?!

lines.en: : The same way you live knowing he’s boning my sister every night while you do your homework.
lines.zh: : 就像你明知道他每晚都在干我姐、而你还在写作业,也照样活着一样。

lines.en: : By masturbating and wishing it was me instead?! Also, it's very bold of you to assume I do my homework!
lines.zh: : 靠边自慰、祈祷那是我?!另外,你敢假设我写作业,胆子真大!

lines.en: : I had to masturbate to them for years, damn it! Don’t tell me you’re throwing in the towel already, weakling!
lines.zh: : 我他妈对着他们俩自慰了好几年!别告诉我你这就想认输,弱鸡!

lines.en: : Aaaaah but it’s so hard! I can’t take it anymore!
lines.zh: : 啊——可是好难!我受不了了!

lines.en: : Well, take it for a little while longer because now is my time to shine, sister!
lines.zh: : 那就再忍一会儿,因为现在轮到我闪闪发光了,妹妹!

lines.en: : Noriko? Ami? Are you...both in there?
lines.zh: : Noriko?Ami?你们……都在里面?

lines.en: : J...Just a second?!
lines.zh: : 等……等一下?!

lines.en: : Yeah! We’re...almost done!
lines.zh: : 对!我们……快好了!

lines.en: : With what?
lines.zh: : 弄什么?

lines.en: : Now look what you two have done.
lines.zh: : 现在看看你们俩干的好事。

lines.en: : Us?! This is all your fault, Nii-chan! If you had only waited another ten minutes, you wouldn’t be getting assaulted right now and I wouldn’t be a sacrifice!
lines.zh: : 我们?!这都怪你,Nii-chan!你要是再多等十分钟,你现在就不会被袭击,我也不会成为祭品!

lines.en: : Hah...I have an idea.
lines.zh: : 哈……我有主意了。

lines.en: : All I ask...
lines.zh: : 我唯一的请求……

lines.en: : Is that you do not forget this sacrifice...
lines.zh: : 是请你们不要忘记这场献祭……

lines.en: : Ami? Where are you-
lines.zh: : Ami?你在哪——

lines.en: : The time has come...for Ami Arakawa...
lines.zh: : 时机已到……轮到 Ami Arakawa……

lines.en: : To do something good...
lines.zh: : 做一件好事了……
